title: Unrelated business taxable income — Riverside Arts Center
instructions: Riverside Arts Center, a §501(c)(3) corporation, has the activities below. Compute its UBTI and tax.

exhibits.title: Activities
exhibits.content:
- A café open to the public, staffed by paid employees: revenue **$200,000**, directly connected expenses **$150,000**
- An office building it rents out: rent **$100,000**, expenses **$40,000**; average acquisition debt **$300,000**; average adjusted basis **$1,000,000**
- Royalties for licensing its logo: **$20,000**
- A gift shop run entirely by volunteers: net income **$50,000**

rows.label: UBTI after the specific deduction
rows.explanation: 50,000 + 18,000 − 1,000 = **67,000**; royalties and volunteer-run activities are excluded.

rows.label: Could a loss from the café offset income from a different unrelated business?
rows.explanation: Each unrelated trade or business is computed separately.
